name: Benki Sensou
source:
A super-dynamic action shooting visual novel that depicts battles centered around the mysterious substance known as “UNKO.” 
In the game section, you’ll engage in fast-paced battles using the Toilet Machine, while in the VN sections you’ll experience life in the military alongside muscular beastmen.
By raising your ERP (Ero Points) gauge and leveling up, you’ll be able to steer the story towards erotic directions.
translation:
一部超动态的动作射击视觉小说，描绘了以被称为“UNKO”的神秘物质为中心的战斗。
在游戏部分，你将使用厕所机进行快节奏的战斗，而在VN部分，你将与肌肉发达的野兽人一起体验军队生活。
通过提高你的ERP（Ero Points）指标并升级，你将能够将故事引向色情方向。
